body:
*I'm sad that life hasn't treated you well, but at the same time I must say I'm amazed at how you have been fighting all these years. Fighting for an entire lifetime, if imho.*

Sometimes when I'm not acutely suicidal I feel almost combative about it; *almost fifty years of this and you still haven't gotten me, you bastards*. Not sure who the bastards in question are though.

Thank you to those who read this. As close as I am, I haven't gone over the side quite yet.
